summary: I installed the three accepted PDFs and the reviewed canonical web edition, and wired the publication. Before installing, I confirmed the artifact snapshot was current: `_proper_study.py check --phase artifacts --require-presentation --require-format` exited 0, and every build PDF and every sealed .aux and .log file matched research/artifacts.json. I then ran `make install-doc DOC=<id> PROVIDER=claude` once for each output, with nothing suppressed: no -o, no -t, no timestamp or dependency change, and no source edit. Make found all three PDFs current and retypeset nothing. It ran its metadata checks and copied the bytes. Each build PDF and each installed PDF matches its accepted SHA-256: the 34-page study 5dd437b0355d8fb1d20896f6e0a4d4dd31eeba738e2fa8f91adf4c990560821b, the 12-page concise study ea145b8e60cc2c651bf78f417cdfbcef68ea91582a76bbd334f56e7f05a3a161 and the 3-page homily 62a1014c221118c3f432069eecba1147615d723dcfebb25b062d5e52eb2d4bb7. Because no hash differs, I report no artifact defect. I copied build/web/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/58-eighteenth-after-pentecost.md byte for byte to web/claude/... (132,138 bytes, 12acf5ccdbe373e848bf5fc5657e7e45387ab6316f5284e6f2622cd706ace915; cmp clean) and staged it. No companion web leaf exists. `make add-publication` created three new release records under release/publications/claude/... at status alpha. Each names library/traditional-latin-mass.md and perpetual-public-repository-2026. No record existed before, so none was overwritten. In the catalog, only the Claude cell of row 58 changed, from Planned to Full PDF, Synthesis PDF, Homily PDF and Read, in the manifest's label order. I added one marker, claude:liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/58-eighteenth-after-pentecost, which carries the prefix because gpt is the primary provider. `make document-catalogue` regenerated corpus.json, and a work-by-work comparison shows only this leaf's work added. I ran `make refresh-release-bindings ADOPT=1 ONLY=` on the catalog page, the web edition and corpus.json. It made five changes and adopted nothing else. `tools/tpt source-inventory refresh` added the leaf to the Claude publication inventory (1 document and 34 files, nothing else changed). I then set its classification row by auditing its 83 bound sources: finding-aid, historical-primary, institutional-current, liturgical, patristic, scholastic, scripture and secondary. `classify` applied the row, and `check`, `make check-publication-inventories` and `make check-sources` all exit 0. The completed reviews and the installation facts are recorded in research/production-review.md. I ran the five gate commands myself. `--phase publication`, `public-alpha check`, both document-library checks and `check-web-editions-current` exit 0. `make check-release-bindings` exits 2 on 16 bindings this stage did not write. They are scripts/_proper_components.py, sources/index.json and 14 source-edition projections, all committed earlier on this branch. PROJECT-WORK.md records the maintainer's 2026-09-23 rebind approval of exactly those, to be applied by the driver at publication-gates. All three paths this stage bound are exact. Nothing is committed.
